production.title: The end of a study session
production.channel_style: hand-drawn 2D ink illustration on textured cream paper, muted ochre and charcoal, no photorealism
production.avoid: text, captions, letters, watermark, logo, signature, frame, border, collage, split screen
production.visual_bible: A woman in a red sweater sits at a wooden desk beside a left-side window. A book and a cup are on the desk.

storyboard.narration: She closes the book and decides to rest.
She turns to look out of the window.

shots.purpose: Show the student concluding her work by closing her book, establishing a quiet, reflective atmosphere.
shots.camera_detail: Static eye-level locked framing focused on the woman seated at her desk with the window softly framing screen-left.
shots.opening_frame: Hand-drawn 2D ink illustration on textured cream paper. A woman in a red knit sweater sits in profile at a rustic wooden desk. An open hardbound book and a ceramic cup sit before her, bathed in soft window light from the left.
shots.subject_action: Her hands gently meet at the edges of the open book, folding the cover shut with a calm, deliberate gesture before resting her palms flat beside it as she exhales.
shots.environment_motion: A faint curl of delicate steam rises steadily from the ceramic cup on the desk.
shots.lighting: Soft diffused daylight enters from the screen-left window, rendering muted ochre highlights and charcoal ink crosshatching.
beats: She sits still over the open book, hands resting lightly at the paper edges.
She lifts the right cover and steadily closes the volume shut.
Her hands settle flat beside the closed book as her shoulders ease downward.
shots.continuity: Establishes the woman's red sweater, wooden desk, cup, closed book, and window-left lighting for Scene 2.

shots.purpose: Capture the internal transition to resting as her gaze shifts out the window into the distance.
shots.camera_detail: A very gentle, grounded slow push-in framing her profile as her attention drifts toward the window.
shots.opening_frame: Hand-drawn 2D ink illustration on textured cream paper. Close-up profile of the woman in the red sweater, eyes cast downward in thought, the corner of the closed book visible at the bottom edge.
shots.subject_action: She smoothly turns her head toward the screen-left window, her expression softening into a relaxed, contemplative gaze out toward the light.
shots.environment_motion: Subtle dust specks drift slowly through the soft shaft of window daylight across the paper surface.
shots.lighting: Warm, muted ochre daylight softly illuminating her facial profile against deep charcoal ink shadows.
beats: She pauses with eyes lowered in quiet thought.
Her head turns gradually toward the bright left-side window.
She rests her gaze outward with a serene, settled expression.
shots.continuity: Maintains the red sweater, 2D ink line work on cream paper, and consistent light direction from the left window established in Scene 1.
